title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Factory on 1969-02-14
lineage: SBD > MC > C > C(?) > D > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a bit of hiss and muffling captures a raw, high‑energy 1969 show highlighted by a stellar Dark Star and tight interplay on The Eleven.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its powerful early‑Dead vibe, especially the first‑set Dark Star, an inspired The Eleven, and an electric closing to the Cryptical suite. While the soundboard source suffers from constant hiss and slight muffling that give it a cassette‑like character, all instruments remain clear enough to enjoy the show’s high energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars and highlight strong musical moments; recording issues are noted but not enough to detract significantly, yielding an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Constant hiss and slight muffling give a cassette‑like feel, but all channels are clear and instruments can be heard distinctly.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Raw, powerful early‑Dead set with smooth transitions (e.g., Dark Star into St. Stephen) and strong improvisational interplay throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for fantastic leads on Dark Star, The Eleven and the Cryptical suite; tone described as perfect and electric.
band_member_comments.Phil: Interplay with Jerry on The Eleven highlighted as "as good as it gets," with a notable bass line under the motif.
